CustomField.label: Record POC
CustomField.description: Tags which learning POC/app created this Account. This org hosts multiple unrelated POCs sharing the standard Account object (see instruction.md Section 16) — this field is how Accounts created by the Invite Only Onboarding Portal's automation stay identifiable/filterable apart from Coral Cloud's or any other app's Account data. Not on any page layout by design — it's a backend tag, not something a user edits.
